folds.title: What a skill is
points: A **skill** is a folder of instructions, sometimes with scripts and resources.
Claude loads it when a task calls for it.
Think of it as a recipe card Claude can pull out.

folds.title: Only what is needed
points: Claude checks which skills fit your request.
That keeps its desk, the context window, from filling up with instructions it does not need.

folds.title: Where skills come from
points: **From Anthropic**: like making Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.
**Custom skills**: ones you or your organisation write for your own routines.

folds.title: Making and finding skills
points: A simple skill is just written instructions in Markdown. No coding needed.
Skills also work in Claude Code.
To browse them in the app, open Customize, then Skills.

folds.title: A team report skill
points: Your team writes a report every week, always in the same layout and tone.
You put that routine in a custom skill.
Now "Write this week's report" is enough. Claude loads the skill and follows it.

folds.title: Review before you trust
points: Skills can include scripts, so treat them like any app.
Review a skill before you rely on it.
Take extra care with one that someone else wrote.

folds.prompt: Skill or not? Tap the basket.

items.text: Every report follows my team's layout and tone
items.why: A repeatable routine is exactly what a skill holds.
